The affix घ generally comes in the sense of an instrument or location after a root, when the word to be formed is a name and is in the masculine gender.

Terms: घ

The feminine affix ङीष् comes after a word when it expresses the name of a wife in relation to her husband.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीष्

The feminine (unless it ends in ऊ) having an equivalent and uniform masculine becomes masculine in a कर्मधारय समास and before 1. जातीय and 2. देशीय।

Terms: Masculisation

असुङ् (अस्) is substituted for the final of पुंस् in the strong cases.

Terms: Some substitution
